# Most B2B marketing teams don’t lack tools. | Mandar Marathe · LinkedIn · 2026-04-28

**Mandar Marathe**: Vice President Marketing at UPTIQ for 1 year 7 months with 20 years 11 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Co-Founder at Koppr, Visiting Faculty for Digital Marketing at Indian Institute of Management, Sirmaur, and Visiting Faculty for Digital Marketing at Great Lakes Institute of Management. Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India [IN].

---

Most B2B marketing teams don’t lack tools.

They lack a marketing operating system.

Campaigns live in silos.

Content isn’t tied to pipeline.

Sales and marketing aren’t aligned.

Analytics doesn’t connect to revenue.

We ran into the same challenge at Uptiq.

As we scaled, we realized we needed something different - not more campaigns, but a structured AI-powered marketing operating system.

So we built one.

Today, our AI Marketing OS connects:
Strategy → Content → Demand Gen → Conversion → Sales → Analytics

Here’s what this enables us to do:
• Use AI to define ICP and refine messaging
• Scale thought leadership and content production
• Turn campaigns into predictable demand generation
• Optimize conversion across landing pages and funnels
• Support sales with AI-driven insights
• Track what actually drives pipeline

The biggest shift for us:
AI is no longer just helping us create content.

It’s helping us run marketing as a system.

Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India [IN].

🚨 SEO is changing faster than most teams realize.
For years, the playbook was simple:
➡️ Find keywords
➡️ Create content
➡️ Build backlinks
➡️ Wait for rankings

But now?
People are increasingly getting answers directly from AI.

No clicks.
No website visits.
No traditional search journey.

Which means the question is no longer:
"How do I rank on Google?"

It's becoming:
"How do I become the answer AI chooses?"

🤖 That's where AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) comes in.

✅ Identify content gaps using real search data
✅ Generate content ideas based on business intent
✅ Create detailed briefs automatically
✅ Draft optimized content in minutes instead of days

# One of the conversations I've been enjoying lately is with our design team around AI and creativity. | Mandar Marathe · LinkedIn · 2026-07-01

**Mandar Marathe**: Vice President Marketing at UPTIQ for 1 year 7 months with 20 years 11 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Co-Founder at Koppr, Visiting Faculty for Digital Marketing at Indian Institute of Management, Sirmaur, and Visiting Faculty for Digital Marketing at Great Lakes Institute of Management. Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India [IN].

---

One of the conversations I've been enjoying lately is with our design team around AI and creativity.

There's a common narrative that AI will replace designers.

After speaking with [Nimish P.](https://linkedin.com/in/nimish-patole), our visual designer, I think the reality is far more interesting.

What AI is really changing is how designers work, not why they create.

Traditionally, a lot of time goes into research, collecting references, brainstorming ideas, creating variations, and exploring different creative directions.

AI dramatically accelerates those early stages.

Today, Nimish uses AI to generate naming ideas, explore mood boards, experiment with visual concepts, and create multiple content variations in minutes instead of hours.

The strategic thinking hasn't changed.
